rules.title: Minimal API Pattern
rules.check: New endpoints SHOULD use Minimal APIs (app.MapGet) over Controllers.
rules.bad_example: public class UserController : ControllerBase { ... }
rules.good_example: app.MapGet("/users", async (UserDb db) => ...);

rules.title: ProblemDetails for Errors
rules.check: Errors MUST return RFC 9457 ProblemDetails.
rules.bad_example: return BadRequest("Something went wrong");
rules.good_example: return Results.Problem(detail: "User not found", statusCode: 404);

rules.title: OpenAPI Documentation
rules.check: All endpoints MUST produce OpenAPI/Swagger documentation.
rules.bad_example: app.MapGet("/data", () => "data"); // No metadata

rules.title: Request Validation
rules.check: Inputs MUST be validated (FluentValidation or DataAnnotations).
rules.bad_example: app.MapPost("/users", (UserDto u) => db.Save(u));

rules.title: Response Typing
rules.check: Endpoints MUST use explicit TypedResults or return types.
rules.bad_example: public async Task<IActionResult> Get() { ... } // Unknown return shape
rules.good_example: public async Task<Results<Ok<User>, NotFound>> Get() { ... }

rules.title: Versioning Strategy
rules.check: APIs MUST be versioned (URL or Header).
rules.bad_example: app.MapGet("/api/users", ...);
rules.good_example:
var v1 = app.NewVersionedApi("1.0");
v1.MapGet("/api/v1/users", ...);

rules.title: Idempotency
rules.check: Critical mutations (POST/PUT) SHOULD support Idempotency Keys.
rules.bad_example: // Charge logic that runs twice if network fails
rules.good_example: // Middleware checks "Idempotency-Key" header before executing

rules.title: Rate Limiting
rules.check: Public APIs MUST have Rate Limiting enabled.
rules.bad_example: app.MapGet("/heavy-calculation", ...); // Abusable
rules.good_example: app.MapGet("/heavy-calculation", ...).RequireRateLimiting("fixed");

rules.title: Pagination
rules.check: List endpoints MUST support pagination.
rules.bad_example: return await db.Users.ToListAsync(); // Could return 1M rows
rules.good_example: return await db.Users.Skip((page-1)*size).Take(size).ToListAsync();

rules.title: Health Endpoints
rules.check: Services MUST expose /health or /healthz.
rules.bad_example: // No health check configured
rules.good_example: app.MapHealthChecks("/health");

rules.title: Response Compression
rules.check: Large responses MUST enable compression (Brotli/Gzip).
rules.bad_example:
// No compression configured - large JSON responses sent uncompressed
app.MapGet("/data", () => GetLargeDataset());

rules.title: Request Size Limits
rules.check: Endpoints MUST configure max request body size to prevent DoS attacks.

rules.title: Cache Headers
rules.check: Cacheable responses MUST have appropriate Cache-Control headers.
rules.bad_example:
app.MapGet("/static-data", () => GetRarelyChangingData());
// No cache headers - browsers/CDNs can't cache

rules.title: Correlation Header Propagation
rules.check: APIs MUST propagate correlation/trace headers to downstream services.
rules.bad_example:
// Calling downstream service without propagating trace context
var result = await _httpClient.GetAsync("https://other-service/api");

rules.title: Endpoint Extension Methods
rules.check: API endpoints MUST be defined as extension methods on IEndpointRouteBuilder in dedicated {Resource}Endpoints.cs files.

rules.title: Static Routes Class
rules.check: Route paths and names MUST be defined in a static Routes class, not inline strings.
rules.bad_example:
group.MapGet("/api/v1/media/{id}", GetById)
    .WithName("GetMediaById");

rules.title: Endpoint Metadata Chain
rules.check: Endpoints MUST declare complete metadata: name, produces, validation filter.
rules.bad_example:
group.MapGet("/{id}", GetById);
// No metadata - poor OpenAPI docs, no validation
rules.good_example:
group.MapGet("/{id}", GetById)
    .WithName(Routes.Media.Names.GetById)
    .WithSummary("Get media by ID")
    .WithDescription("Returns media metadata and download URLs")
    .Produces<MediaDto>(200)
    .Produces(404)
    .ProducesValidationProblem()
    .AddEndpointFilter<ValidationFilter>();

rules.title: Orchestrator Pattern for Business Logic
rules.check: Endpoints MUST NOT contain business logic. Use an I{Domain}Orchestrator service.

rules.title: HTTP Client Handler Pipeline
rules.check: HTTP clients MUST use a handler pipeline with correlation, logging, and retry policies.
rules.bad_example:
services.AddHttpClient<IExternalApi, ExternalApiClient>();
// No handlers - no correlation, no logging, no retry
rules.good_example:
services.AddHttpClient<IExternalApi, ExternalApiClient>()
    .AddHttpMessageHandler<RequestCorrelationHandler>()
    .AddHttpMessageHandler<HttpLoggingHandler>()
    .AddPolicyHandler(GetRetryPolicy())
    .AddPolicyHandler(GetCircuitBreakerPolicy());

private static IAsyncPolicy<HttpResponseMessage> GetRetryPolicy() =>
    HttpPolicyExtensions
        .HandleTransientHttpError()
        .WaitAndRetryAsync(3, retryAttempt =>
            TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Math.Pow(2, retryAttempt)));

rules.title: Service Registration Extension Pattern
rules.check: Service registration MUST use extension methods on IServiceCollection with IConfiguration parameter.
